#define EDNS_OPT_LIST_APPEND_EDE(LIST, REGION, CODE, TXT) 		\
	do {								\
		struct {						\
			uint16_t code;					\
			char text[sizeof(TXT) - 1];			\
		} ede = { htons(CODE), TXT };				\
                verbose(VERB_ALGO, "attached EDE code: %d with"		\
                        " message: %s", CODE, TXT);			\
		edns_opt_list_append((LIST), LDNS_EDNS_EDE, 		\
			sizeof(uint16_t) + sizeof(TXT) - 1,		\
			(void *)&ede, (REGION));			\
	} while(0)
